steps.content: Your curiosity getting the better of you, after checking behind several doors, you find yourself back in the corridor, now nearly empty of people.

Some spectators are tailing the main squad, while others have already slipped behind these doors, embracing roles meant just for them. It's quite astonishing to see how many have already started to "play their roles."
As you look along the extended hallway, you can't help but wonder with growing excitement what the final act of this play will be.
Caught up in your reflections, you suddenly become aware of a strange sound behind you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What? Just because you're at a loss, you resort to dragging others down into the show with you...?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you try to assault me here, I'll make sure you serve a real sentence after you've served your fake one here at the theater.
The footsteps are getting louder, inching ever closer.
You grip the fountain pen you habitually carry in your pocket, seizing the moment the footsteps behind halt, and whirl around!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Chief?!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ignis?!
You and Ignis face off in a peculiar standoff in the theater's hallway. After a brief pause, Ignis exhales deeply, dropping her guard.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: At last, I found you!! I was worried that you hadn't come over from the other stage, so I figured I'd hang around here and wait!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: But everyone who came to me was a performer, each one more convincing than the last! I... I...
Ignis's voice fades to a whisper. You move closer, intrigued, and catch her grumbling under her breath.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I even started to suspect... that Chief was just a performer they'd roped in...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't worry, I'm the real deal, your actual Chief.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: The shackles clued me in! I trust you! Come on, let's get moving!
Under the luminescent lights, Ignis's cheeks are flushed with a hint of crimson. She purses her lips, strides past you, and heads onward.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I ran into Luvia just now! She wants us at the stage down the hall when the bell rings three times. Says she's got a surprise for us!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A surprise? Luvia's an actress after all. She must be in her element here.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Right, and I just... ahem... caught wind of the actors saying to break free from this "prison," we've got to make it to the far end of the hallway. So we have to go there anyways.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Pretty impressive~
You kept it to yourself, not letting Ignis know that you've seen every bit of her interplay with the performers.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're very sharp today, even deciphering the hints woven into their dialogue.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Well, obviously—I'm smart!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yeah, yeah. Sure you are.
Catching the big smile on your face, Ignis swiftly averts her gaze.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Hurry up and keep up!! If you wander off and get lost again, I'm not coming after you!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Okay, okay, I'll stay right on your heels. Promise not to get lost and be a bother again!
You stride quickly to keep up, taking in your surroundings as you go.

The hallway is dotted with many doors, and occasionally, one or two NPCs can be seen standing guard. Some are garbed in costumes, others in everyday clothes more typical outside the theater. But each of them watches you with a distinctly theatrical expression.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The lady running this theater is something else, managing so many performers in such a massive space... all to make sure the audience in every corner gets fully drawn in...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The writhing colorful chaos is shattered, and it releases its grip on Hella. She falls from mid-air and is caught by you, just barely.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Right, I remember that as well.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Luvia mentioned that's what makes this theater a hit.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's curious, though, how she manages to direct these performers who just pop up in the show spontaneously.
Just as you try to take a closer look at each NPC's face, stepping through that last door triggers a sudden burst of light, forcing you to squint.

steps.speaker: Culprit A
steps.content: Oh look, two more poor souls wandered in!
In a blur, a piercing voice suddenly cuts through.
The noise around you builds up. Once your eyes adapt to the brightness, you realize that a caged stage, different from the one you had just seen, unfolds in front of you.
